2014_spells.investiture-of-stone.effectS: Deal 1d10 force damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.investiture-of-stone.fullDes: Using 1 action, • You can use your action to create a tremor in a 15-foot radius extending from you in a direction you choose. If you do so, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space, taking 1d10 force damage and falling prone; Other creatures on the ground in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC. Until the spell ends, bits of rock crumble from your body, and you gain the following benefits: • You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
